goal: First prove page-by-page visual understanding of the official ONE PIECE CARD GAME Home, News, Products and Events pages from complete source observation; only then prove generative reuse on a separate held-out page.

evidencePolicy.consumerRule: Interpreter is blocked until every required page has frozen full-page capture, continuous playback, lossless frames, timeline coverage and extracted screenshot/region/DOM/computed claims.

evidenceFidelity.claim: Every high-salience visual decision must trace to observed evidence and its approved semantic role.

structuralFidelity.claim: Composition, hierarchy, information density and interaction semantics must survive translation.

generativeProof.claim: At least one held-out page must reuse frozen recipes with source-independent content and no one-to-one source page mapping.

learningProofContract.compensationPolicy: A pass in one proof cannot compensate for a failure in another.

generativeChallenge.contentChange: Create a representative event announcement fixture chosen after the reusable recipes are frozen.
forbiddenShortcuts: source screenshot or crop as runtime asset
one-to-one recreation of an official Events page
logo, brand colors or official wallpaper as the only recognizable brand cues

mustPreserve.description: The home preview preserves the official hero's dominant campaign composition, visual weight and asset hierarchy.
The News preview preserves the official page's filter/header relationship, repeated editorial rows, metadata hierarchy and page density.
The products preview preserves the official catalog's grid density, product-first hierarchy and browsing rhythm.
The Events preview preserves the official event index's actual heading, category/filter controls, event-card hierarchy, metadata and browsing density; unsupported reservation actions are forbidden.

Warm story surfaces, hard black typography and black-white taxonomy controls remain distinct roles. Yellow is admissible only for a captured menu-open indicator or inside campaign artwork; it must not become generic active, title or button chrome.

mayTranslate.description: Desktop columns may be compressed into a phone layout without removing the defining composition or density pattern.
The full catalog may use representative items, but the result must still read as a merchandise catalog rather than a generic card list.

mustNotReplace.description: Unused CSS, token names and asset filenames may not establish a visible semantic role without a matching rendered capture and observed state.
Logo, official assets and brand colors may not substitute for matching composition, hierarchy and information density.
Implementation may not introduce a new translation justification after seeing the result.
